answer: Standing is granted only after an applicant is assigned one living fruit tree in a walled orchard and composes a sonnet whose line-final letters encode that tree's graft tag. A uniquely banded raven, trained by the applicant alone, must speak two of those lines at an unscheduled dusk roll-call while a leaf snip is DNA-matched to the graft ledger. Dossiers that reuse a tree, poem, or bird are merged and slashed as one farm. An attacker who wants N keys must raise N grafts, write N unique sonnets, and train N ravens that cannot answer two roll-calls in the same dusk hour.
